facts.value: Private CaptureLeadead collision-event adapter that forwards its Fighter_GObj unchanged to ftCo_80090780. Its shared caller invokes it on a zero collision result, not the baseline's claimed ground-loss result.
facts.rationale: Canonical registration and negated condition override inferred naming.

facts.value: Receives the original fighter object synchronously from ft_8008403C when ft_80082708 returns zero and forwards it unchanged to ftCo_80090780, with no local dereference, storage or mutation.
facts.rationale: Corrects the prior failed-ground premise while preserving exact flow.

facts.value: Always delegates to ftCo_80090780. That routine conditionally calls ftCommon_8007D5D4 for GA_Ground, then uses ftGetParasolStatus!=-1 to select ftCo_800CF4DC; otherwise it enters numeric state 0x26 with flags 0x18001, clamps air drift, and calls ftCommon_8007EBAC(fp,8,0). Gameplay meaning of the numeric destination is not asserted.
facts.rationale: Retains exact optional branches without importing rendered DamageFall semantics.

facts.value: CaptureLikelike registers this adapter as death2_cb. It forwards gobj to ftCo_800C7A30, which forwards the stored item to it_802DBA68. That helper requests it_802DBAF0(item,0,1), writes x4C=120, and calls it_802D9DDC. Victim processing and clearing of x50, atk_victim and grab_victim occur only if msid!=8 and non-null grab_victim equals x50; the selected victim call uses angle 0 and attr+0x64.
facts.rationale: Repairs the librarian's overly broad retained clearing claim.

facts.value: Source-defined void(Fighter_GObj*) state-entry routine. It derives an Item_GObj* from Fighter.dmg.x1868_source and stores it in mv.co.captureleadead.x0; there is no separate item parameter or local null validation.
facts.rationale: Exact source signature and derivation, without compiled-match or localized identity claims.

facts.value: Initializes fighter-side CaptureLeadead: performs preceding helper calls, enters the state, installs item-notifying damage/death callbacks, stores the damage-source item, computes and seeds grab/mash bookkeeping, sets fighter flags, calls it_802EAAEC for item attachment and requests a small camera quake.
facts.rationale: Canonical operations establish purpose without helper aliases or localization.

facts.value: Has no local eligibility guard. After preceding calls, enters ftCo_MS_CaptureLeadead with flags 0x1080, frame 0, rate 1, zero final scalar and NULL, then initializes callbacks, source-item reference and computed grab timer. No finite/range validation is present. The state's IASA/Phys callbacks are empty; Anim processes timer and mash input; Coll delegates to ft_8008403C rather than proving a ground-loss transition.
facts.rationale: Separates actual local operations from unsupported family assertions.

facts.value: Reads Fighter.ground_or_air, facing_dir and common x370; writes -facing_dir*x370 to gr_vel for GA_Ground, otherwise self_vel.x. Forwards gobj to Fighter_ChangeMotionState for CaptureCut, then copies x73C to capture_timer. The nonselected velocity field is not locally assigned.
facts.rationale: Exact branch and product avoid unconditional recoil-direction assumptions.

facts.value: Initializes CaptureCut release after CaptureLeadead timer completion or attached Leadead destruction, assigning a selected horizontal velocity field and capture_timer. Item detachment belongs to the verified callers, not this routine.
facts.rationale: Both callers and division of responsibilities are verified.

facts.value: GA_Ground selects gr_vel=-facing_dir*x370; all other values select self_vel.x with the same product. Both paths enter CaptureCut with flags 0, frame 0, rate 1, zero final scalar and NULL, then set capture_timer=x73C. No local guard, clamp or finite check occurs; opposite-facing recoil depends on input signs and values.
facts.rationale: Covers both branches, ordering and exceptional-input limits.

facts.value: Performs CaptureLeadead animation-phase escape-timer processing: subtracts a configured step, applies common mash processing, and on resulting timer<=0 notifies the stored item before initializing fighter CaptureCut release. No animation-completion test is used.
facts.rationale: Canonical timer operations establish role without localization or guaranteed reduction.

facts.value: Subtracts leadead_grab_timer_step, calls ftCommon_GrabMash with leadead_grab_break_threshold as a per-event subtraction amount, ignores its result, then tests grab_timer<=0. The helper may subtract once for buttons and once for changed remembered stick direction. Both signed zeros pass; NaN fails. Item notification precedes fighter release. No clamp or positivity/finite validation exists; negative amounts may increase time and small positive decrements may round away, so termination is not unconditional.
facts.rationale: Adds exact order, helper meaning, float boundary and numerical-progress limits.

facts.value: Supplies CaptureLeadead's collision callback by passing the fighter and fn_800C77E0 to ft_8008403C. The event forwards to ftCo_80090780. Current canonical zero-result invocation contradicts the baseline ground-loss description.
facts.rationale: Exact delegation replaces unproved intended behavior.

facts.value: Passes gobj and fn_800C77E0 to ft_8008403C. Its ft_80082708 call updates collision positions, invokes mpColl_8004B108 and writes Fighter.cur_pos back. Only a zero result synchronously forwards the original object to the event, which forwards it unchanged to ftCo_80090780. The shared helper does not retain the callback pointer.
facts.rationale: Verifies cross-file object flow and callback lifetime.

facts.value: Unconditionally calls ft_8008403C. That helper invokes fn_800C77E0 only for !ft_80082708(gobj). The pinned implementation returns GA_Air when fall_off_ledge is true and GA_Ground otherwise; their values are 1 and 0. Thus the event runs on the GA_Ground result and is skipped on GA_Air. Intended ground-loss behavior and compiled agreement remain unresolved.
facts.rationale: Explicit enum/caller proof supersedes baseline polarity.

facts.value: Supplies the empty CaptureLeadead IASA callback. It performs no local input handling or action selection; the separate Anim callback processes grab mashing. This alone does not prove engine-wide action restrictions.
facts.rationale: Restricts purpose to provable local behavior.

facts.value: Returns without using gobj, testing input, invoking helpers, mutating state or initiating transitions. This is callback-local no-op behavior only.
facts.rationale: Removes unsupported collision/global restriction appendages.

facts.value: Returns without using gobj, testing guards, updating velocity or timers, invoking helpers or changing state. External fighter/item processing is not constrained by this local no-op.
facts.rationale: Preserves invariant empty-body behavior without ground-loss or engine-wide movement claims.

facts.value: Owns CaptureLeadead entry, timer/mash animation processing, empty IASA/physics callbacks, collision delegation and its private event adapter, plus CaptureCut release initialization. Also supplies the death adapter registered by neighboring CaptureLikelike entry. Ground-loss interpretation, localized ReDead imagery and compiled .sdata2 layout are not established.
facts.rationale: Complete canonical TU scope and explicit unresolved boundaries.

facts.value: Entry initializes CaptureLeadead, callbacks, source-item storage and computed grab timer. Anim subtracts a configured step, applies mash processing and on resulting <=0 notifies/detaches the item before CaptureCut initialization. IASA/Phys are empty. Coll delegates to a helper that currently invokes its event on zero/GA_Ground, not GA_Air. CaptureCut writes selected horizontal velocity and capture_timer; Leadead destruction is another caller. The final adapter forwards CaptureLikelike death notification through the shared damage-notification path. Object lifetime and effective numerical progress remain external requirements.
facts.rationale: Repairs lifecycle summary with verified polarity and conditional progress/lifetime limits.
